PAN-OS 12.1.5 Known Issues

The following table lists the known issues in PAN-OS 12.1.5.

Management Plane Known Issues

Issue ID Description
PAN-300001 Panorama may display stale device state information after HA failover.
PAN-300002 Configuration push to device groups may timeout with large rule bases.
PAN-300003 Log forwarding to external syslog servers may experience delays during high traffic.

Data Plane Known Issues

Issue ID Description
PAN-300004 Session distribution may be uneven across dataplane processors under specific conditions.
PAN-300005 IPSec tunnel may fail to establish with certain third-party devices.

GlobalProtect Known Issues

Issue ID Description
PAN-300006 GlobalProtect portal may not respond to satellite requests during certificate renewal.
